description: This file implements the RunC container management class and its administrator, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state querying, and configuration handling, specifically for runc runtime integration.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Handles execution of runc commands such as create, exec, delete, state, list, and version, including process management and environment variable inheritance.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a runc-based container, managing its lifecycle, state, and resource metrics.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory class responsible for initializing and creating runc containers based on configuration files.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator, retrieves runc version.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates and returns a container object based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container if running.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory resource information for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU resource information for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interface information (not implemented, returns nullptr).

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Deletes the container if it is running.
